mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", username AS "username", display_name AS "displayName", role AS "role", enabled AS "enabled", last_login_at AS "lastLoginAt", created_at AS "createdAt" FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (tenant_id, username, display_name, role, password_hash, salt) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, #{param5}, #{param6})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET role = COALESCE(#{param3}, role), enabled = COALESCE(#{param4}, enabled), password_hash = COALESCE(#{param5}, password_hash), salt = COALESCE(#{param6}, salt) WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
mapper.select: SELECT occurred_at AS "occurredAt", username AS "username", action AS "action", entity_type AS "entityType", entity_id AS "entityId", result AS "result", ip AS "ip", "before" AS "before", "after" AS "after" FROM audit_log WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND (#{param2}::text IS NULL OR action = #{param2}) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT #{param3}

SELECT p.id AS "id", COALESCE(ec.code, '*') AS "code", p.scope AS "scope", p.strategy::text AS "strategy", p.max_attempts AS "maxAttempts", p.priority AS "priority", p.enabled AS "enabled", COALESCE(p.params->>'origin', 'manual') AS "origin" FROM recovery_policy p LEFT JOIN error_code ec ON ec.id = p.error_code_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY p.priority, p.id
mapper.update: UPDATE recovery_policy SET strategy = COALESCE(#{param3}::recovery_strategy, strategy), max_attempts = COALESCE(#{param4}, max_attempts), priority = COALESCE(#{param5}, priority), enabled = COALESCE(#{param6}, enabled), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM error_code WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND code = #{param2}) AS "codeExists", (SELECT count(*) FROM error_occurrence e JOIN error_code c ON c.id = e.error_code_id WHERE e.tenant_id = #{param1} AND c.code = #{param2}) AS "historyHits", (SELECT count(*) FROM recovery_policy p LEFT JOIN error_code c ON c.id = p.error_code_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{param1} AND p.enabled AND p.priority < #{param3} AND (p.error_code_id IS NULL OR c.code = #{param2})) AS "shadowed"

SELECT e.fingerprint AS "fingerprint", max(e.error_code_id) AS "codeId", max(e.resource_id) AS "resourceId", count(*) AS "hitCount", min(e.occurred_at) AS "firstAt", max(e.occurred_at) AS "lastAt", max(e.severity::text) AS "severity", (array_agg(e.outcome ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC))[1] AS "lastOutcome", (array_agg(e.message ORDER BY e.occurred_at DESC))[1] AS "lastMessage", COALESCE(max(s.status), 'open') AS "state", max(s.assignee) AS "assignee", max(s.note) AS "note" FROM error_occurrence e LEFT JOIN alert_state s ON s.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND s.fingerprint = e.fingerprint WHERE e.tenant_id = #{param1} AND e.severity::text <> 'info' AND e.resolved_at IS NULL GROUP BY e.fingerprint ORDER BY "hitCount" DESC, "lastAt" DESC LIMIT #{param2}

SELECT a.fingerprint AS "fingerprint", a.status AS "status", a.note AS "note", a.assignee AS "assignee", a.closed_at AS "closedAt", a.updated_at AS "updatedAt", r.code AS "deviceCode", r.name AS "deviceName", ds.online AS "online", ds.last_heartbeat AS "lastHeartbeat", CASE WHEN ds.online = false THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - ds.last_heartbeat))::bigint ELSE NULL END AS "offlineSec" FROM alert_state a LEFT JOIN resource_node r ON a.fingerprint = 'DEVICE-OFFLINE|' || r.id LEFT JOIN device_state ds ON ds.resource_id = r.id AND ds.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{param1} AND a.fingerprint LIKE 'DEVICE-OFFLINE|%' ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.status = 'open' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, a.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{param2}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_state (tenant_id, fingerprint, status, assignee, note, acked_at, closed_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{param1}, #{param2}, #{param3}, #{param4}, #{param5}, CASE WHEN #{param3} = 'acked' THEN now() END, CASE WHEN #{param3} = 'closed' THEN now() END, now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, fingerprint) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, assignee = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.assignee, alert_state.assignee), note = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.note, alert_state.note), acked_at = COALESCE(alert_state.acked_at, EXCLUDED.acked_at), closed_at = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'closed' THEN now() ELSE alert_state.closed_at END, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND role = 'admin' AND enabled
